title: Fix: Admin-added questions not appearing in topic/category filters

requirements.summary: Merge backend-stored admin questions with local static questions in all frontend topic/year filtering views so admin-added questions appear in the topic browser, year browser, and quiz generation flows
acceptanceCriteria: When a user browses by topic (e.g., 'Ilmul Advia'), questions added via the Admin Panel appear in that topic's list alongside the static questions.
When a user browses by year, admin-added questions for that year appear in the list.
Starting a quiz from a topic or year group includes admin-added questions for that topic/year.
The UI correctly reflects the total count of questions including admin-added ones.

file_operations.description: Add a new React Query hook `useAllQuestions` that fetches questions from both the backend via `actor.getQuestions()` and the local static `questions` array from `data/questions.ts`, then merges them into a single deduplicated array. This hook will serve as the unified question source for all filtering operations.

Replace the direct import of the static `questions` array with the new `useAllQuestions` hook from `hooks/useAdminQueries.ts`. Update the component to handle loading and error states from the query. Ensure that the topic and year grouping logic operates on the merged question set, so that admin-added questions appear in their assigned topic/year sections.

Replace the static `questions` array reference with the `useAllQuestions` hook to calculate accurate question and topic counts that include both static and admin-added questions. Display loading state while fetching, and show the correct total counts once data is available.

If QuizScreen receives a pre-filtered question set from TopicBrowserScreen or HomeScreen, no changes are needed here. However, if QuizScreen independently filters questions (e.g., for random quiz generation), replace the static `questions` import with the `useAllQuestions` hook and update the quiz generation logic to draw from the merged question pool.
